mapper.sql: record.id AS record_id, record.result_id, record.task_id, task.task_no, result.attempt_no, meter.id AS meter_id, meter.meter_no, meter.meter_name, meter.meter_type, meter.unit, record.reading_value, record.reading_at, record.source_type, record.executor_id, CASE record.source_type WHEN 'METER_READER' THEN reader.username WHEN 'DEVICE' THEN device.device_no END AS executor_code, CASE record.source_type WHEN 'METER_READER' THEN reader.display_name WHEN 'DEVICE' THEN device.device_name END AS executor_name, record.reviewed_by AS reviewer_id, reviewer.display_name AS reviewer_name, record.reviewed_at

FROM meter_reading_record AS record INNER JOIN meter_reading_result AS result ON result.id = record.result_id INNER JOIN meter_reading_task AS task ON task.id = record.task_id INNER JOIN meter ON meter.id = record.meter_id LEFT JOIN sys_user AS reader ON reader.id = record.executor_id AND record.source_type = 'METER_READER' LEFT JOIN device ON device.id = record.executor_id AND record.source_type = 'DEVICE' INNER JOIN sys_user AS reviewer ON reviewer.id = record.reviewed_by
